verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no product feature for defining event-triggered rules or automations. The only event mechanism is a checkout-status webhook (sumup-docs-41), which is a developer building block: the user would have to write their own logic to act on it. The POS plan's "automated marketing" is a different, adjacent feature, not user-defined event rules. Neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
